summary: FASE G-6 (Transaksi Antar Entitas) backend fully verified. 13/13 pytest cases pass: login, meta, summary, create dokumen kembar (pair_id, seller+buyer, subtotal 500000 + PPN 11% = 555000), fixed_price tanpa kontrak ditolak 400, siklus ship→receive→invoice, interco_accounts INV-IC-02 (receivable=payable=555000), GL posting balanced double-book (seller: Dr 1-1250=555000, Cr 4-1000=500000, Cr 2-1200=55000, plus HPP Dr 5-1000/Cr 1-1300; buyer: Dr 1-1300=500000, Dr 1-1500=55000, Cr 2-1250=555000), INV-IC-05 PPN keluaran==PPN masukan, partial settlement (200k → status tetap invoiced, settled_amount=200000, outstanding 355000), full settlement (sisa 355k → status 'settled' pada kedua sisi, outstanding 0), list settlements.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/gl/journal defaults to active_entity_id scope; caller wanting cross-entity view must pass entity_id=all. Not a bug, but worth documenting for UI dev of ledger antar-PT layar.

interco_service.create() posts GL when submit_now=True (bypassing confirm() approval-threshold check). If large-value approval is required, submit_now should either be blocked at high value or route through confirm() to enforce approval_threshold_rupiah. Currently role-check only fires di path draft→confirm.

config antar_entitas.settlement_reminder_days references consumer services/interco_service.py:balance_reminders which is not implemented (hanya aging_days & reminder_active dihitung inline di list_accounts). Not blocking, but misalignment with registry.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing ent_ksc, ent_kanda entities + prod_batik_mega product). Cleanup step in fixture drops interco_transactions/accounts/settlements + journal_entries for interco source_types.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_interco_g6.py is idempotent — cleans interco collections before running. GL journal endpoint requires entity_id=all query param for cross-entity views. ent_ksc default_tax_mode='ppn' (PKP), ent_kanda default_tax_mode='non_ppn'. PPN 11% applies when seller is PKP under ppn_mode=ikut_pkp (default).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found; two initial test failures were test-script issues (wrong endpoint path /api/gl/entries → /api/gl/journal, and missing entity_id=all for cross-entity scope). Both fixed in test file; backend behaviour correct.
